mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona City Hall and a Waning Gibbous moon. You can spot the ISS passing overhead tomorrow morning at 5:07 AM, rising near Verona High School and traveling toward the Fitchburg area. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 39 degrees with no rain expected.

Regarding city news, alternate side winter parking begins November 20 through April 1 to assist with snow removal. Also, the Water Utility is conducting cross-connection inspections, so please watch your mail for a request to schedule an appointment to help keep our water supply safe.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360, or play trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Tomorrow, look forward to Main Street Trick-Or-Treat, live music at Bailey's Run, and live music at Lake Lou-ee.
In a noteworthy call from last Sunday, October 19, a 49-year-old man was taken into custody on an active arrest warrant during a traffic stop for a suspended license.

The Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
